title: Scaling Generative Foundation Models for Chest Radiography with Rectified Flow Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual image editing of the 'Sex' demographic attribute in chest radiographs, measuring edit effectiveness using attribute predictors (ROCAUC) and evaluating patient identity preservation via structural similarity (SSIM) and perceptual feature distances (LPIPS).

Counterfactual image editing of the 'Race' demographic attribute in chest radiographs, measuring edit effectiveness using attribute predictors (ROCAUC) and evaluating patient identity preservation via structural similarity (SSIM) and perceptual feature distances (LPIPS).

Counterfactual image editing of the 'Age' demographic attribute in chest radiographs, measuring edit effectiveness using Mean Absolute Error (MAE) for age prediction, and evaluating patient identity preservation via structural similarity (SSIM) and perceptual feature distances (LPIPS).
